_how_to_use: The agent's part of a trend research run (G2, TR3-TR7, TR8 text): the handoff's templates/picks_template.json plus the score table (TR5, required). Copy to <run>/03_wip/picks_v01.json (a new version for every change: picks_v02.json, ...), fill it after reading the latest growth, the evidence (tm research evidence) and the Ad Library summary, check it with tm research picks check --run R --file 03_wip/picks_vNN.json, then build the page with tm research report --run R --picks 03_wip/picks_vNN.json. Numbers are NOT written here: the page takes them from growth. Every sentence must rest on the data (R3); a hypothesis is worded as one. Keys starting with '_' are ignored; delete the ones marked _when when they do not apply.
category: <the category as the page names it, e.g. beauty>
as_of: <YYYY-MM-DD, the day the trend data was read (the run date)>
_outputs: the run's chosen outputs in the page's words: report always; digest with the weekly digest; paid with the paid view

moves.why: <one or two sentences: event-bound (with the dates and where they come from), crowded in paid (with advertisers), general and mature hook, ...>

act_now.id: <trend id, in the order to show>
act_now.maturity: <early | early in paid | established | established hook>
act_now.what: <what it is: the structure from the evidence videos (opening, shots, text, slot fills), what the newest posts change>
act_now.how: <how to use it: who, which format, the first two seconds, when>
act_now.risk: <status, concentration, language of the evidence when obvious, sensitivity when flagged, paid crowding, seasonality>

act_now_other.note: <why it is 'act now' by the numbers but not recommended yet>

_scores: one row per act now and still rising pick, each criterion a whole number 1-5 (TR5); the page weights them by scoring.weights

lens._when: only when a focus (lens) was given at intake (TR5); otherwise delete this key
lens.label: If you are <a nail brand>
lens.note: <one sentence on who this is for>

items.line: <lead with / pair with / skip / over, and why, in one sentence>

watch_next: <what is starting but not yet a trend in the data; worded as a hypothesis>
_paid_reading: only when the paid view is chosen; otherwise delete paid_reading
paid_reading: <the openings: rising in organic, none found in Ad Library titles>
<slowing in organic while paid is crowded>
<what cannot be checked: hooks are Not checkable without Foreplay>

digest_reading._when: only when the weekly digest is chosen and this run has a digest (tm research digest ran at F2); otherwise delete this key
summary: <4-5 sentences: calls that held, what ended, what moved up, what is new, what is starting>
